world.era: invented fantasy world, no stated year
world.eraEvidence: narration: the Malazan Empire, gods and sorcery; no real-world date
world.setting: a Malazan campaign at the siege of the city of Pale, with desert plains, the floating fortress Moon's Spawn above, and the warrens of magic

whiskeyjack.name: Whiskeyjack
whiskeyjack.role: sergeant of the Bridgeburners squad, the book's point of view
whiskeyjack.look: a weathered middle-aged soldier, lean build, close-cropped grey hair, dusty leather armour and a cloak, Malazan army period dress

tattersail.name: Tattersail
tattersail.role: high mage of the Malazan army
tattersail.look: a young woman mage, slim build, long dark hair tied back, robes in dark blue with a cloth wrap, Malazan army period dress

rake.name: Anomander Rake
rake.role: a powerful Tiste Andii lord who fights from the moonspawn
rake.look: a tall pale-skinned man with black hair, dark armour and a long cloak, a lord's bearing, fantasy battlefield dress

quickben.name: Quick Ben
quickben.role: Bridgeburner sorcerer and a survivor of the squad
quickben.look: a wiry middle-aged man, thin build, unkempt hair, a wool tunic and a sash, soldier's dress

laseen.name: Empress Laseen
laseen.role: the ruler of the Malazan Empire, far behind the lines
laseen.look: a composed older woman, regal bearing, rich imperial robes and a crown-like headdress, Malazan court dress

pin.name: Pin
pin.role: a squad member who dies in the carnage
pin.look: a young soldier, sturdy build, short brown hair, leather jerkin over a tunic, Malazan infantry dress

pale.look: the walled city of Pale under siege, stone streets and burning buildings, ruined and smoky

plains.look: flat dusty plains outside the city, mud and trenches, dawn light

moonspawn.look: the floating black-stone fortress Moon's Spawn, massive and hovering over the battlefield

warren.look: a sorcerous warren, a dim otherworldly space of shifting light and shadow

councilRoom.look: a dim imperial council chamber far behind the lines

objects.why: the siege of Pale and the grinding campaign are the book's core subject
death without ceremony, the soldiers who die for orders they never understand
the walled city of Pale the army is besieging
sorcery and burning brazers, the magic that hits the people below
the soldiers' protection and the defences the magic breaks through
the long march the squad is pushed along toward the front
the chaos of magic and battle that the grunts are caught inside

spine.claim: the Bridgeburners sit in the mud outside Pale, following orders no one explains
the squad is pushed into the fight while sorcery and the empire's politics play out above them
the magic of the gods and ascendants breaks into the battle and the soldiers pay the cost
the dead are counted without ceremony and the survivors carry what they saw
the book leaves its larger mysteries unresolved on purpose

signatureObjects.name: Moon's Spawn
signatureObjects.why: the floating black-stone fortress hovering over the battlefield at Pale; no shared icon depicts it
